in_sanskrit.name: Prashik
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Asker, Seeker, Inquirer
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Prashik एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Prashik is a Sanskrit and Hindi name for a person who asks questions or seeks knowledge. This name is derived from the Sanskrit root 'prash' meaning to ask or to inquire. Prashik is a name for someone who is curious, inquisitive, and thirsts for knowledge. It is a name for someone who is always asking questions and is eager to learn new things.
